post-tgr-thermodynamic-horizon-identific.physical_scope: An additional reversible heat and entropy-state-function identification on the selected connected, strictly subextremal, zero-magnetic-flux stationary Kerr–Newman family, conditional on identifying the selected reduced exponential-current reference temperature with the same horizon generator's positive geometric surface gravity. It asserts no entropy microstate count, general Hawking or KMS result, dynamical-process law, or empirical reading.

post-tgr-thermodynamic-horizon-identific:
## Postulate

Use the connected strict subextremal parameter domain
$\mathcal P:=\{(m,a,q)\in\mathbb R^3:m>0,\ m^2>a^2+q^2\},$
with its physical Kerr–Newman family and SI conversion as in [[pthm-tgr-kn-family-mechanics]]. Fix positive constants $G_N$ in $\mathrm{m^3\,kg^{-1}\,s^{-2}}$, $c$ in $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$, $\hbar$ in $\mathrm{J\,s}$, and $k_B$ in $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}$. Write $E_{\rm par}:\mathcal P\to\mathrm J$, $A_H:\mathcal P\to\mathrm{m^2}$, $J_{\rm SI}:\mathcal P\to\mathrm{kg\,m^2\,s^{-1}}$, $Q_e:\mathcal P\to\mathrm C$, $\Omega_{\rm SI}:\mathcal P\to\mathrm{s^{-1}}$, and $\Phi_{\rm SI}:\mathcal P\to\mathrm V$ for the smooth parameter functions supplied by [[pthm-tgr-kn-family-mechanics]].

Define the work-subtracted reversible heat one-form on $\mathcal P$ by
$$\delta Q_{\rm rev}:=dE_{\rm par}-\Omega_{\rm SI}\,dJ_{\rm SI}-\Phi_{\rm SI}\,dQ_e.$$
Here a one-form assigns a linear functional to each tangent direction in the family parameter domain; each term has units of joules. Let $S_H:\mathcal P\to\mathbb R$ be a $C^1$ function with values measured in $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}$. It is a state function here in the explicit sense that its value is assigned to each family parameter point and does not depend on a path used to reach that point.

Assume the mathematical premise $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ of [[def-countable-choice]] required by the selected spectral supplier. This is not a physical postulate.

Let $\kappa_{\rm geom}>0$, in $\mathrm{m^{-1}}$, be the geometric coefficient $\nabla_\chi\chi=\kappa_{\rm geom}\chi$ for the same selected generator $\chi$ and reference normalization used in the physical family, as defined conditionally in [[def-tgr-framework-units]]. Identify the inverse-length parameter $\kappa$ of the reduced exponential-current branch in [[pthm-tgr-reduced-horizon-temperature]] with this $\kappa_{\rm geom}$. Adopt the additional reference-temperature identification $T_K:=T_{\rm red}$, where $T_{\rm red}$ is that supplier's effective reference temperature. In this postulate $T_K$ names only the selected reference scale in the reversible relation; it is not a local proper-temperature field and does not assert a stationary bath, a KMS state, or an observed detector reading.

Adopt the reversible thermodynamic identification
$$\delta Q_{\rm rev}=T_K\,dS_H$$
throughout this selected family. This physical identification is an additional assumption. The geometric family identity and the reduced effective-temperature model do not by themselves assert it. No global entropy zero or identification with a quantum-gravity microstate count or an unrenormalized outside-state entropy is adopted.

pthm-tgr-area-entropy-calibration.physical_scope: Conditional deduction on the selected connected, strictly subextremal, zero-magnetic-flux stationary Kerr–Newman family, using the exact SI family differential, the explicitly adopted reversible heat and entropy state function, and the reduced exponential-current effective reference temperature identified with the same generator. It does not assert a general Hawking or KMS theorem, a dynamical-process first law, an empirical temperature, a microstate count, or an absolute entropy zero.

pthm-tgr-area-entropy-calibration:
## Statement

Use the physical Kerr–Newman family parameterized by the connected strict subextremal domain
$$\mathcal P:=\{(m,a,q)\in\mathbb R^3:m>0,\ m^2>a^2+q^2\},$$
with its current SI parameter map and selected horizon conventions from [[pthm-tgr-kn-family-mechanics]]. Assume $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ as defined in [[def-countable-choice]], the mathematical premise used by the current Kerr–Newman and reduced spectral supplier proofs. Let $S_H:\mathcal P\to\mathbb R$ be the $C^1$ entropy state function adopted in [[post-tgr-thermodynamic-horizon-identification]], measured in $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}$. Assume the selected reduced exponential-current reference temperature is identified with the same generator's positive $\kappa_{\rm geom}$, exactly as in that postulate. Then there is a constant $s_*\in\mathbb R$, with units $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}$, such that throughout $\mathcal P$
$$S_H=\frac{k_B}{4\ell_P^2}A_H+s_*=\frac{k_Bc^3}{4G_N\hbar}A_H+s_*,\qquad \ell_P^2:=\frac{G_N\hbar}{c^3}.$$
The deduction determines the area coefficient within this adopted model and leaves the entropy zero unselected. It does not identify $S_H$ with a statistical microstate count or an outside-state entropy.

texp-tgr-horizon-entropy-difference.physical_scope: Conditional entropy difference for two positive-mass states on the selected zero-spin, zero-charge Schwarzschild slice of the same connected, strictly subextremal stationary family. It is a model deduction with no measured black-hole entropy, microstate count, general Hawking claim, or selected absolute entropy zero.

texp-tgr-horizon-entropy-difference:
## Statement

Assume $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ as defined in [[def-countable-choice]], inherited from the conditional mathematical spectrum input. Let $m_{*,1},m_{*,2}>0$ be two physical mass parameters on the zero-angular-momentum, zero-electric-charge Schwarzschild slice of the selected family in [[pthm-tgr-kn-family-mechanics]]. Assume that the conditional area calibration [[pthm-tgr-area-entropy-calibration]] applies on the same connected family. Then the entropy difference between these two model states is
$$S_H(m_{*,2})-S_H(m_{*,1})=\frac{4\pi k_BG_N}{\hbar c}\left(m_{*,2}^2-m_{*,1}^2\right).$$
The additive entropy constant cancels. This is a conditional model deduction, not an observation or a construction of a statistical microstate count.
